verdict.rationale: Terraform provides review-gate building blocks. Plans can be previewed, saved with -out and applied exactly later, and apply prompts for approval by default unless -auto-approve is passed. Machine-readable JSON plans support automated review, and HCP Terraform policies validate plans with UI override, while community users credit execution plans with preventing surprises. However, nothing shows least-privilege credential scoping for an agent, and the official MCP server only exposes docs, modules and policies rather than gated plan/apply. Missing for 10: least-privilege/scoped credential support for agent runs, a documented agent-specific approval workflow that blocks unapproved applies, and hands-on corroboration of agent-driven gated applies.
